items.name: Rheinmetall Group backlog, FY2025
items.claim: Rheinmetall reported a Group order backlog of EUR 63.8 billion as of December 31, 2025, up from EUR 46.9 billion a year earlier; the figure includes both binding order backlog and framework agreements (frame backlog).
items.source_excerpt: On December 31, 2025, the Rheinmetall Backlog was €63.8 billion, a new high, after €46.9 billion in the previous year. This figure includes both binding order backlog and framework agreements (frame backlog).

items.name: Weapon and Ammunition segment order volume (Rheinmetall Nomination), FY2025
items.claim: Rheinmetall's Weapon and Ammunition segment achieved an order volume (Rheinmetall Nomination) of EUR 7,126 million, exceeding sales by more than 100%, though this fell short of the previous year's level of EUR 12,307 million, which had been lifted by a significant framework agreement for artillery ammunition.
items.source_excerpt: Weapon and Ammunition once again achieved an order volume (Rheinmetall Nomination) of €7,126 million, exceeding sales by more than 100%. However, this fell short of the previous year's level of €12,307 million, which was influenced by a significant framework agreement for artillery ammunition.

items.name: 155mm artillery ammunition order for international customer
items.claim: Rheinmetall announced a major order from an international customer to supply 155mm artillery ammunition, a low five-figure quantity of shells with delivery expected for 2027, at a contract value in the low three-digit millions of euros.
